title: Find All Duplicate Values
description: An array `nums` has length `n`, and each value is between 1 and `n`. Values occur once or twice. Return all values that occur twice, in increasing order. Input: `nums`. Output: the sorted duplicate values.
constraints: Each value appears at most twice
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
